subject.title: fix(stream): recover visible content when reasoning_delta straddles an inline code span (closes #96869)

question: Should OpenClaw recover native reasoning_content as visible text when the visible stream is inside an unclosed inline code span, and what invariant should protect private reasoning text while doing that?
rationale: The requested repair changes the user-visible/private-reasoning boundary, and the current patch is a heuristic that source review shows does not yet cover the reported same-chunk provider shape.
